description: Read one ContexteTech resource, usually right after search_resources or when the user gives a code or page URL. Accepts the short code (end of the page URL, e.g. 'jr6t0n'), 'author/name', or 'code#v2' for a fixed version. Always returns title, type, licence, language, source, version and page URL; plus, for a dataset, the total number of rows, the first rows (default 10, max 50); for a prompt, the template and its {{variables}} (then call fill_prompt); for a context, the system prompt, knowledge and examples. The result ends with a Source line (resource, author, original data source, publisher, licence): citing it with its links is required. Fails with an error if the code does not exist or the resource is private.

code.description: Short code (end of the resource URL)

name: load_resource
title: Load a resource
